ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SANITY_POWER.descriptio:
At 8 stacks, trigger a Neural Damage burst.
Deal damage equal to 20% of the target's max HP, up to 30.
After bursting, the next burst deals an additional 15% of max HP and its damage cap increases by 15.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SANITY_POWER.title: Neural Damage
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SANITY_MULTIPLIER_POWER: The next Neural Damage burst deals {Amount}% more damage and its damage cap increases by {Amount}.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SANITY_UNLIMIT_POWER.de: Each stack increases Neural Damage burst's damage cap by 20.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SANITY_BURST_POWER.desc: Whenever Neural Damage bursts, gain 1 [blue]Damage Unbound[/blue].
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SANITY_THORNS_POWER.des: Whenever you take damage, apply an equal amount of [blue]Neural Damage[/blue] to the damage source.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-STEALTH_POWER.descripti: The next damage you take is reduced by 30%. At the start of each turn, lose 1 stack.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-STEALTH_POWER.title: Stealth
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ERODE_TIDE_POWER.descri:
Whenever you play a card, apply [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [blue]Neural Damage[/blue] to all enemies.
Clears automatically at the end of your turn.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ERODE_TIDE_POWER.title: Eroding Tide
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BLUE_SEED_POWER.descrip: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Energy.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BLUE_SEED_POWER.title: Deep Blue Seed
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SANITY_BUFF_POWER.title: Aggravated Damage
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SANITY_BUFF_POWER.descr: Your next attack applies {Amount} additional [blue]Neural Damage[/blue].
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEA_CREATURE.title: Seaborn Form
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEA_CREATURE.descriptio:
The cost of resting tide.
Take 25% more damage and deal 50% more damage.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HUMAN.title: Human
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HUMAN.description: Deep blue as the starry sky.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHADOW_FLAG_POWER.title: Following Shadow
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHADOW_FLAG_POWER.descr: For each [gold]Haste[/gold] card you play this turn, deal 1 damage to enemies at end of turn.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHADOW_POWER.title: Following Shadow
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHADOW_POWER.descriptio: At end of turn, deal {Amount} damage to all enemies.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHEILD.title: Tentacle Barrier
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHEILD.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Haste[/gold] card, gain 1 Block.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SUPER_SPEED_POWER.title: Haste Form
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SUPER_SPEED_POWER.descr: Whenever you play a Haste card, draw 1 card.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ADAPT_PAIN_POWER.title: Pain Adaptation
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ADAPT_PAIN_POWER.descri: Whenever you lose HP 4 times, prevent the next HP loss.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-FLOATING_SEA_BLOCK_ACTI: Once per turn, give an allied character 5 Block.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HARVEST_ATTACK_ACTION.d: Once per turn, deal 4 damage to all enemies.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SAC_CRAWLER_SANITY_ACTI: Once per turn, apply 2 Neural Damage to all enemies.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SAC_CRAWLER_SANITY_POWE: Every 3 Seabornization increases Neural Damage by 1.
Neural Damage requires 2 fewer stacks to burst.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEABORNING_POOL.title: Breeding Pool
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEABORNING_POOL.descrip: At the start of your turn, add 2 [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] to the bottom of your draw pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-CALL_OF_SEA_POWER.title: Call of the Deep
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-CALL_OF_SEA_POWER.descr: After you play your next other card, give your Floating Sea Drifter and Bowl-Sea Reaper one active action each.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HIVE_WILL_POWER.title: Hive Will
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HIVE_WILL_POWER.descrip: At the start of each turn, give all your summoned minions {Amount} Seabornization.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-PAIN_ECHO_POWER.title: Pain Echo
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-PAIN_ECHO_POWER.descrip: Whenever you trigger a Neural Damage burst, draw {Amount} cards.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ABERRANT_REGENERATION_P: Whenever you lose max HP, gain that much Block. If upgraded, draw 1 card the first time this triggers each turn.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHEILD_POWER.title: Tentacle Barrier
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHEILD_POWER.descriptio: Whenever you play a Haste card, gain {Amount} Block.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BLUE_LIFE_BLOOM_POWER.d: When combat is won, gain {Amount} max HP.
While you have this power, whenever you lose 1 max HP, gain 1 stack. At the end of combat, restore max HP equal to this power's stacks.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-TIDE_REFLECTION_POWER.d: This turn, whenever you play a Haste card, gain {Amount} Block and apply {Amount} Neural Damage to a random enemy.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-PERFECT_ABERRATION_POWE: Whenever you lose max HP, gain that much Strength. Whenever you gain max HP, deal 3 times that amount as damage to all enemies.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-COLD_POWER.title: Cold
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-COLD_POWER.description: At the start of the player's turn, lose {Amount} Energy. At the end of the player's turn, lose this effect.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEABORNING_POOL_POWER.d: At the start of each turn, add {Amount} [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] to the bottom of your draw pile.
